description: List attendees (one per sold ticket) of one event OR of all of an organization's events. Each attendee carries checked_in, cancelled, refunded, status, ticket_class_name, profile and barcodes (status unused/used). Pass exactly one of event_id / organization_id. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/attendees/ or GET /organizations/{organization_id}/attendees/.

changed_since.description: Only attendees changed on or after this time, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

event_id.description: Event ID — list this event's attendees.

organization_id.description: Organization ID — list attendees across all its events.

status.description: attending = Attending or Checked In; not_attending = Not Attending or Deleted; unpaid (event only) = order not paid.

name: eventbrite_list_attendees
title: List attendees
